answer: Harberger slot bond: each identity claims one yarrow plot on the knoll, files a quill-signed declaration of 450, locks 70. Each epoch it pays 45 tax; the knoll ledger publishes it; anyone may buy it at its price. Unpaid tax or one quill key signing many plots burns the bond: the rented-quill ring. 1,000 fakes pay 1,000 x 45 = 45,000 per epoch, above the 40,000 pool; declaring 100 invites a buyout. Honest holders pay 45 once and keep plots.
